name: strato
description: Work with Strato DHF records and sync designs and verification coverage.

interface.shortDescription: Work with Strato records, designs, and verification.
interface.longDescription: Ask Strato to find, explain, or update DHF records. Use the design and verification sync skills to reconcile local engineering work, test coverage, and result traceability with Strato. Requires a Strato MCP connection. Findings appear in chat; selected changes follow normal governance. Verification sync does not execute tests or write Test Runs.
defaultPrompt: Use $strato to show the requirements for this product.
Use $strato-design-sync to reconcile this project with its Strato specifications and designs.
Use $strato-verification-sync to reconcile local tests with Strato Test Cases and propose test mappings.
